# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 82 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 82 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_082_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Chapter 5

**1** "Are there then no others who will enter the tower?" I asked. He answered, "There are those who entered the tower, and those who did not, yet shall enter. **2** But all those who do not repent shall not enter the tower." **3** "Then tell me," I said, "what those who have repented must do to enter the tower." **4** He said, "Their rods shall be cut and planted by him who gave them; and if any of them take root, and none of them wither, they shall live. But if any wither, they shall die." **5** I said, "Lord, and if they repent but do not purify themselves and live righteously after repenting — will they still enter the tower?" He said, "Repentance that does not bear fruit shall not bring them into the tower. For they must bear fruit worthy of repentance." **6** "But are the rods not to be taken from them who had given them back? Did they not receive the seal?" **7** "No," he said, "the seal belongs to the water. They go down into the water dead and come up alive. Therefore the seal was also preached to these, and they make use of it to enter the kingdom of God." **8** "Why then, Lord," I said, "did the forty stones come up first from the deep and fit together in the tower, the corners and sides? **9** He said to me, "Because these were the first who believed and were foremost among the righteous, the apostles and teachers who preached the name of the Son of God and who fell asleep in the power and faith of the Son of God." **10** "Why then," I said, "did the virgins also take part in the building of the tower, carrying the stones?" **11** "Because they are holy spirits, and they are the powers of the Son of God. Without these no one can enter the kingdom of God; for if one takes the name upon himself but does not receive from these virgins their clothing, he shall not benefit at all — for these virgins are the powers of the Son of God."

---

*EMET note: the forty stones are the apostolic foundation; the virgins are virtues/holy spirits that clothe believers for entry. The seal (sphragis) = baptism.*
